note: Language pack for English. Every URL and extraction rule is data — edit here, no recompile. Add a language by creating languages/<Name>/source.json. Strategies: 'regex' (capture group on body), 'json' (follow dot 'path', then optional 'match'), 'span' (tolerant nested-span IPA reader). 'group' = regex capture group. 'confirm' = regex (with {word}) the body must match. 'normalize' = strip IPA delimiters/entities.

sources.name: Cambridge
sources.note: Cambridge serves per-entry mp3 audio via site-relative <source> src attributes; 'prefix' makes them absolute. The first audio/mpeg source is the headword pronunciation.

sources.name: Naver
sources.note: Naver English dictionary search API. The audio URL is the opaque, token-bearing 'symbolFile' of the first phonetic symbol (e.g. .../009123.mp3?_lsu_sa_=...). The API returns an empty body without a Referer header, so one is declared here.
